description: Work with Auvik network monitoring: read clients, devices, interfaces, networks, configuration backups, components, warranties and lifecycles, list and dismiss alerts, pull device, interface and service statistics, and start workflows on new or cleared alerts, new or offline devices, configuration changes and failing components.

auvik_alert_cleared_trigger.description: Runs when an Auvik alert clears (the problem is resolved), with what it was about. Alerts cleared before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.alert: The whole alert as Auvik gives it
output.alert_id: The alert's ID, for 'Get alert' and 'Dismiss alert'
output.entity_id: The ID of the device, interface, network or service it is about
output.link: A link that opens the alert in Auvik
output.name: The alert's name, such as Device Offline
output.status: created for a new alert, resolved for a cleared one
output.tenant_id: The ID of the client it is in

parameters.description: Only this Auvik client (or multi-client). Leave empty for every client your Auvik user can see.
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.description: Only alerts of this severity: emergency, critical, warning or info. Leave empty for every alert.
parameters.name: severity

auvik_component_problem_trigger.description: Runs when a device component (a fan, disk, power supply, CPU or memory) becomes degraded or fails. Components already in that state when the workflow is turned on don't start it, and one starts it again each time it goes from OK to degraded or failed. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.component: The whole component as Auvik gives it
output.component_name: Its name, such as Power Supply 1
output.component_type: cpu, disk, fan, memory, powerSupply and so on
output.device_id: The ID of the device it is in
output.device_name: The name of the device it is in
output.link: A link that opens it in Auvik
output.tenant_id: The ID of the client it is in

parameters.description: Only this Auvik client (or multi-client). Leave empty for every client your Auvik user can see.
parameters.name: tenant_id

auvik_configuration_changed_trigger.description: Runs when Auvik backs up a device's changed configuration, with the device and when. Backups taken before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.backup_time: When Auvik took the backup (ISO 8601, UTC)
output.configuration: The whole backup record as Auvik gives it
output.configuration_id: The backup's ID, for 'Get configuration backup'
output.is_running: Whether it is the device's running configuration
output.link: A link that opens the device's configurations in Auvik
output.tenant_id: The ID of the client it is in

parameters.description: Only this Auvik client (or multi-client). Leave empty for every client your Auvik user can see.
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.description: Only this device's configuration. Leave empty for every device.
parameters.name: device_id

auvik_device_offline_trigger.description: Runs when a device Auvik monitors goes offline, with when it was last seen. Devices already offline when the workflow is turned on don't start it, and a device starts it again each time it goes offline. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.device: The whole device as Auvik gives it
output.device_id: The device's ID, for the device steps
output.device_type: Its type, such as switch, router or firewall
output.last_seen_time: When Auvik last saw it online (ISO 8601, UTC)
output.link: A link that opens the device in Auvik
output.online_status: online, offline, unreachable and so on
output.tenant_id: The ID of the client it is in

parameters.description: Only this Auvik client (or multi-client). Leave empty for every client your Auvik user can see.
parameters.name: tenant_id

auvik_new_alert_trigger.description: Runs when Auvik raises an alert, with its severity, what it is about and a link to it. Alerts raised before the workflow is turned on don't start it. With Auvik's webhook set up (see the setup steps for connecting Auvik) it starts within seconds; without it, how often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.alert: The whole alert as Auvik gives it
output.alert_id: The alert's ID, for 'Get alert' and 'Dismiss alert'
output.entity_id: The ID of the device, interface, network or service it is about
output.link: A link that opens the alert in Auvik
output.name: The alert's name, such as Device Offline
output.status: created for a new alert, resolved for a cleared one
output.tenant_id: The ID of the client it is in

parameters.description: Only this Auvik client (or multi-client). Leave empty for every client your Auvik user can see.
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.description: Only alerts of this severity: emergency, critical, warning or info. Leave empty for every alert.
parameters.name: severity

auvik_new_device_trigger.description: Runs when Auvik discovers a new device, with its type, make and model and IP addresses. Devices already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.device: The whole device as Auvik gives it
output.device_id: The device's ID, for the device steps
output.device_type: Its type, such as switch, router or firewall
output.last_seen_time: When Auvik last saw it online (ISO 8601, UTC)
output.link: A link that opens the device in Auvik
output.online_status: online, offline, unreachable and so on
output.tenant_id: The ID of the client it is in

parameters.description: Only this Auvik client (or multi-client). Leave empty for every client your Auvik user can see.
parameters.name: tenant_id
